description: This Java class manages user preferences related to quick text keys in the AnySoftKeyboard app, including startup tab selection, last selected add-on ID, and popup settings.

classes.name: QuickTextUserPrefs
classes.description: A class that encapsulates user preferences for quick text keys, including startup tab selection and popup behavior.

methods.name: QuickTextUserPrefs
methods.description: Constructor that initializes preferences based on the provided context.

methods.name: isOneShotQuickTextPopup
methods.description: Returns whether the one-shot quick text popup is enabled.

methods.name: getStartPageIndex
methods.description: Determines the initial tab index based on user preferences and available add-ons.

methods.name: getTabIndexByStartUpType
methods.description: Helper method to map startup type string to tab index.

methods.name: getLastSelectedAddOnId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the last selected quick text add-on.

methods.name: setLastSelectedAddOnId
methods.description: Stores the ID of the last selected quick text add-on.
